brief:
Palestinian citizens of Israel are mobilizing for next week's Knesset elections with hopes of unseating Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition, The Guardian reported. The Arab community, traditionally plagued by lower voting rates, is organizing community efforts across towns like Kfar Qasim to boost turnout, motivated largely by opposition to the government's policies.

Organizers frame the election as a decisive moment to dismantle the current ruling coalition. Fear of the far-right agenda has emerged as a primary driver of engagement among Palestinian Israeli voters ahead of polling day.

title: Palestinian Israelis mobilize high turnout bid to oust Netanyahu coalition
